Retrieves all asset audit policy alert notification configurations. Alert notifications define how the system notifies stakeholders when audit events occur, such as when an audit is due, overdue, or completed. This endpoint returns the complete set of alert notification rules, including notification channels (email, in-app), recipient lists, trigger conditions, and message templates. These alerts ensure appropriate visibility into audit compliance and help maintain timely asset verification workflows.
